claim: GEX node attraction is the base rate for any level at that distance, not a mechanical pull.
reopen_if: A new dataset where touch rates at that distance exceed the base rate under a pre-registered test.

claim: Sequence models at this sample size underfit. The binding limit is the number of positive examples, not the architecture.
reopen_if: The positive-example count is no longer the binding constraint.

claim: Two-stage confirmation (entry, then a second confirming step) has widened effective stops and lost to simpler entries.
reopen_if: A one-stage rule on the same data is already closed and a new mechanism is named.

claim: When every trade costs money and there is no edge, the objective is maximised by almost not trading.
rule_for_agent: Do not raise the objective by trading less and less until almost nothing happens. Inactivity is not an answer to the question.

claim: A rule keyed to calendar dates or to a stretch of the sample memorizes the window, which was never a pre-specified test.
rule_for_agent: Do not key a rule to calendar dates or to a stretch of the sample. A condition must be something you can see on the current bar: the session-so-far range, realised vol, or time of day.

claim: A rank or statistic that needs the rest of the session is future data. A whole-session rank as an entry gate collapsed once rewritten causally.
rule_for_agent: Do not use a rank or figure that needs the rest of the session. If it is not in ctx.history(), it has not happened.

claim: Source edits can leave the fill log byte-identical, so the commentary changes and the trades do not.
rule_for_agent: If a proposal's fills are identical to an earlier proposal, the edit did not take effect. Change what is traded, not the commentary.

claim: An agent shown its own prior objectives learns the objective, including on data with no edge.
rule_for_agent: Do not treat a rising objective across proposals as evidence about the market. It can be the search learning the objective.

claim: On this costed objective, a search with no edge converges on almost no trading.
how_it_died: Turnover collapsed to three trades; economics veto on a degenerate optimum; robustness veto on profit concentrated in one session.
reopen_if: A new versioned profile with a turnover floor, not a re-read of these sessions.

claim: After an outsized move inside a session, measured against the session itself, does price continue or give it back?
Does absorption on signed flow mark a turn, and does initiation in the opposite direction make it tradeable?
Auction-market features against a supervised forward-return target, fitted once at the window edge.
